name: Routak
subtitle: Automatic drive logbook
description: Routak records your drives on its own and keeps a searchable history with maps, stats and mileage logs.

apps.name: Routak
apps.subtitle: Your drives, recorded automatically.
apps.localizedDescription:
Routak notices when you start driving and records the trip by itself, then saves it when you park. No buttons to press.

• Every route on a map, colored by speed, with replay
• Pause a trip at a stop and it resumes when you drive off
• Your own labels with a name, color and icon; search and filter by place, date and label
• Home and Work places name your trips automatically
• Weekly stats, a heatmap of where you drive and commute times
• Mileage log as PDF or CSV, fuel cost for each trip
• Export GPX, KML or CSV; import GPX
• Lock Screen Live Activity, widgets and Shortcuts actions (start a trip when CarPlay or your car's Bluetooth connects)
• "Eyes on the road" reminder while the car is moving

In English and Czech. Trips stay on your iPhone; iCloud sync isn't available in AltStore builds.

privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Choose "Always" so Routak can notice when you start driving and record the trip in the background, even when the app is closed.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Routak uses your location to draw the route of your drives on a map.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Routak uses motion activity to tell when you are in a car, so it can start recording drives sooner and save battery.

versions.localizedDescription:
Routak 1.1: pause and continue, custom labels, trip cost

- Pause a trip at a stop; it resumes when you drive off, and a forgotten
  pause or manual trip ends itself ("Still driving?" notification)
- Continue a trip you ended too soon while still nearby
- Pause markers on the map and timeline; replay skips pauses
- Your own labels with a name, color and icon, replacing the three fixed types
- Fuel cost for each trip, with a note that it's an estimate
- Speed chart shows the speed where you touch it
- Trips start where you parked; trips you end yourself are always saved
- Advanced settings for pause length, continue window and joining stops
- What's New screen after updating
- Fix route colors flickering during a replay
- Czech app name Rauťák
